title: Design System: Huevia 相机连接与同步工具原型
scope: Local design guide and approved source-integration contract in docs/design/camera-connection-sync-review only

extensions.cssSourceOfTruth: screen.css; final .dock-button override implements user-selected option B

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Declared incumbent CSS easing; not a new animation requirement

motion.name: shutter-feedback
motion.purpose: One simulated instruction send, then static sent feedback

photoToolbar.left: Photo source and already-read count; product count has + while more pages remain

accessibility.increasedContrast: Use solid card and inset 1px ink border
accessibility.reducedMotion: Disable animations, transitions and smooth scrolling

behavior.cameraToolsScope: Sync only; tab change hides entry and closes panel
behavior.collapsedBadge: Omitted for empty queue; present for active, paused or recoverable queue
behavior.panelReplacement: Downloads and slots replace the tools list; remote opens a dedicated fullscreen page
behavior.connection: Wi-Fi and USB; permission, denied, timeout, retry, cancel and camera confirmation states
behavior.iosWifi: Manual camera-network connection guidance plus local-network permission explanation
behavior.success: Return to calling source; model.loaded=false; photos require explicit browse action

remote.composition: Header/back, camera/transport/battery, settings/histogram/grid tools, preview, four read-only parameters, stable status, recent/shutter/focus
remote.preview: Local assets/alpine-lake.jpg explicitly labeled 取景演示; never a real camera feed
controls: luminance histogram computed from demo still image
remote.parameterDetail: Eight read-only rows; unsupported values shown as —
remote.recent: Empty until new photographs have been verified; sending shutter does not confirm capture
remote.disconnected: Independent connection state; disables shutter and focus
remote.feedback: One 850ms simulated send, then stable sent message

captureUncertainty.queryInitialization: remoteState=uncertain initializes ready preview and capture uncertainty
captureUncertainty.clearAction: remote-acknowledge only, after explicit user verification

remote.focusAvailability: Enabled only when preview is ready, connected, not busy and no capture uncertainty; handler enforces the same conditions
remote.exit: Return to Sync and end this view while retaining connection and capture uncertainty
remote.boundary: All frames, parameters, focus, capture and import switches are local UI demonstrations

behavior.slots: Default unread; read/write previews; confirm overwrite target before simulated write

photoSorting.cameraOrderRestore: Additional action in Flutter product source; HTML shows the four requested options
photoSorting.scope: Already-returned photo metadata only; no extra camera-directory scan
photoSorting.time: Use capturedAt; missing or invalid dates stay last in both directions
photoSorting.name: Numeric natural ordering, ascending or descending
photoSorting.pagination: Insert newly returned pages under the current sort rule
photoSorting.viewer: Follow sorted order while preserving the currently displayed photo handle
photoSorting.independence: Sort entry is between RAW and selection; each control retains its separate purpose

behavior.boundary: HTML prototype makes no camera or system-setting calls; source integration is recorded separately and is not hardware or native-runtime verification

sourceIntegration.authorization: User explicitly approved implementing this design, compact photo toolbar and both time/name sorting
sourceIntegration.status: Flutter source integrated; no Flutter/Gradle/CI/runtime/build/package execution
sourceIntegration.frozenBoundary: Version unchanged; frozen 221 packages and validation records unchanged

narrative.overview:
这是对已实现独立 HTML 原型的扫描记录，适用范围仅为本审核目录。延续既有 Huevia 视觉语言，不建立新的全局品牌规范，也不替代项目根目录的 DESIGN.md。方向依据是 index.html 开头的设计契约、screen.css / screen.js、remote.css / remote-ui.js、board.js 和 README.md。

连接页逐步说明下一件事；同步页保留照片为主体，通过一个浮动入口按需展开工具。用户已选择 B 圆形图标，并追加选择独立全屏遥控取景页。collapsed-options/ 中的三张 ImageGen 设计图及提示词保留为入口选择依据，最终尺寸以代码为准。

用户后续明确批准按此设计接入，并确认紧凑照片工具栏与时间 / 名称两类排序；现已接入 Flutter 源码。接入及验证边界见 implementation/README.md；此记录不表示原生运行、排版或真机验收完成。
keyCharacteristics: 暖白与石墨构成主体，陶土强调状态和选择。
系统字体、清楚的步骤与克制的信息密度。
玻璃集中在浮动控件；下载和槽位使用内容面板，遥控使用摄影暗色全屏页。
dos: Do 保留既有 Huevia 浅深主题和本原型的单圆形入口。
Do 让步骤、失败原因和恢复操作明确可见。
Do 保留减少透明度、高对比度、减少运动与键盘焦点处理。
Do 让全屏遥控的演示标记、只读参数与待核对结果持续明确。
donts: Don't 将三个候选设计图实现成三个产品入口或三个原型。
Don't 持续闪烁就绪提示、重复播报状态，或在空队列显示 0。
Don't 把连接成功等同于加载照片，或把演示槽位和设备状态当作真机结果。
Don't 将本地原型指南扩展为全局品牌变更或产品接入许可。
Don't 将遥控退回小面板、把静态演示图称为真实取景，或自动重发未核对的快门。
